result.title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
result.comment: Accepted at DATE 2027 (Design, Automation and Test in Europe); initial author version
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. Each variant undergoes syntax checking, simulation, formal analysis, off-trigger preservation, security re-scan, and synthesis-based power, performance, and area analysis. We implement REFORGE as a backend-independent repair-and-verification flow and evaluate it in 288 runs across three LLM backends and three benchmark suites. On CirFix, the proposed context and diagnosis increase runs delivering a checked repair from 32/63 to 51/63, while every configuration repairs the Hack@DAC OpenTitan defect. Evidence records also show that a testbench-only criterion reports 3.9 times more repairs than the full set of applicable checks, security-clean outputs may lack functional verification, and different RTL repairs can implement equivalent hardware. These results show that LLM-generated RTL repairs require explicit multi-stage verification evidence rather than a single pass/fail outcome.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 REFORGE，一个 LLM 辅助的 RTL 缺陷修复框架：跨迭代累积结构化修复证据，经语法检查、仿真、形式验证、安全重扫与综合 PPA 多阶段验证后再产出修复变体，并在三种 LLM 后端与三个基准上做评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代累积证据 + 验证反馈驱动诊断」的多目标筛选流程，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、贡献分配以及「何时停止继续检验」的决策设计提供可核查的流程借鉴，但论文属 RTL 代码修复、非多模态推理，迁移价值需自行判断。
